title: metamodel-aasChangeEvent.v1
description: Metamodel-aligned schema for Asset Administration Shell change events. Uses AAS Reference objects as defined in IDTA-01001. Submodel references use ModelReference<Submodel>.

Key.description: A single key within a Reference chain. Corresponds to Key in the AAS metamodel (IDTA-01001).

type.description: The model element type this key refers to.

value.description: The identifier or local ID of the referenced element.

Reference.description: A Reference as defined in the AAS metamodel (IDTA-01001). Can be an ExternalReference or a ModelReference.

type.description: Distinguishes between external references (e.g. IRDIs, IRIs) and model-internal references.

keys.description: Ordered sequence of keys forming the reference path.

referredSemanticId.description: Optional: semantic ID of the referenced element.

ModelReferenceToSubmodel.description: A ModelReference<Submodel>: a navigable reference whose first key has type 'Submodel'. Corresponds to ModelReference<Submodel> in the AAS metamodel.

type.description: Must be 'ModelReference' for a model-internal reference.

keys.description: Reference chain. The first key must have type 'Submodel' and value equal to the Submodel.id.

referredSemanticId.description: Optional: semantic ID of the referenced submodel.

aasId.description: Identifier of the AAS (URI). Corresponds to AssetAdministrationShell.id in the AAS metamodel.

globalAssetId.description: Global identifier of the associated asset (URI). Corresponds to AssetInformation.globalAssetId. Optional; omitted when unknown.

submodels.description: Submodels associated with this AAS as ModelReference<Submodel> objects. Each reference contains the Submodel.id as the first key value and may carry a referredSemanticId.
